地球运动的地理意义 · 3D 互动课件: Geographic Significance of Earth's Motions · Interactive 3D Lesson
PEP Elective 1 · Chapter 1 "Earth's motions" (Section 1 pp.2–6, Section 2 pp.7–14)
自转 → 昼夜交替 · 公转 → 直射点移动: Rotation → day and night · revolution → the subsolar point moves
同一时刻，为什么北京是中午、纽约是半夜，而夏天的白天又比冬天长？: At the same moment, why is it noon in Beijing and midnight in New York, and why are summer days longer than winter days?
自西向东转 1 个太阳日 → 昼夜交替: Turns west to east once per solar day → day and night alternate
沿椭圆轨道走 1 年 → 直射点南北往返: Travels an elliptical orbit in 1 year → the subsolar point moves north and south
东边先见日出 → 15° 差 1 小时: The east sees sunrise first → 15° makes 1 hour
地方时太碎 → 24 个时区 + 日界线: Local times are too fragmented → 24 time zones + date line
直射点 + 晨昏线 → 昼夜长短与正午太阳高度: Subsolar point + terminator → day length and noon sun altitude
地轴、经纬网、晨昏线、昼弧夜弧: Axis, graticule, terminator, day arcs and night arcs
地球一天转一圈，这一圈是怎么转的？: Earth turns once a day. How does it turn?
拖动视角绕地球看半圈：地轴是斜的，地表在它下面转: Drag the view halfway around Earth: the axis is tilted and the surface turns beneath it
地球绕地轴自西向东转（从北极上空看逆时针）；把世界时从 0 拖到 24，地球正好: Earth turns west to east about its axis (counterclockwise seen from above the North Pole); drag universal time from 0 to 24 and Earth turns exactly once = 1 solar day of 24 h
自西向东 · 1 个太阳日 = 24 时 · 角速度 15°/时: West to east · 1 solar day = 24 h · angular speed 15°/h
恒星日 23 时 56 分 4 秒才是自转的真正周期: The sidereal day of 23 h 56 min 4 s is the true rotation period
地球绕地轴转，方向自西向东；从北极上空看是逆时针，从南极上空看是顺时针。: Earth turns about its axis from west to east: counterclockwise seen from above the North Pole, clockwise from above the South Pole.
转一周是 1 个太阳日 = 24 时；以遥远的恒星为参照是 23 时 56 分: One turn is 1 solar day = 24 h; relative to distant stars it is 23 h 56 min 4 s (a sidereal day), the true rotation period.
角速度除南北两极点外各纬相同，约 15°/时；线速度自赤道向两极递减，两极点的角: Angular speed is the same at all latitudes except the two poles, about 15°/h; linear speed decreases from the equator to the poles, and both are 0 at the poles.
去掉这一步：不知道为什么晨昏线是从东往西扫过地面，也不知道地方时为什么东早西晚。: Skip this step and you won't know why the terminator sweeps across the ground from east to west, or why local time is earlier in the east.
常考：从北极上空看逆时针、南极上空看顺时针；自转线速度自赤道向两极递减，两极为零: Common exam point: counterclockwise from above the North Pole, clockwise from above the South Pole; linear rotation speed decreases from the equator to the poles, zero at the poles.
地球绕地轴自西向东自转，周期 1 个太阳日 = 24 时（恒星日 23 时 56: Earth rotates west to east about its axis with a period of 1 solar day = 24 h (the sidereal day of 23 h 56 min 4 s is the true period), angular speed about 15°/h, and linear speed decreasing from the equator to the poles.
facts A2.1 第 3–6 条（教材 p.2–3）、A2.7 要点 1（p: facts A2.1 items 3–6 (textbook pp.2–3), A2.7 point 1 (p.14)
地球绕太阳走一圈，轨道和速度有什么讲究？: What is special about Earth's orbit and speed as it goes around the Sun?
把日期从夏至（172 日）拖到冬至（356 日），看地球走到轨道另一侧、日地距离: Drag the date from the June solstice (day 172) to the December solstice (day 356): Earth moves to the far side of the orbit and the Earth–Sun distance shrinks to 147.2 million km
地球沿近似正圆的椭圆轨道自西向东绕太阳公转，太阳在一个焦点上；从夏至（1.520: Earth revolves west to east around the Sun on a nearly circular elliptical orbit with the Sun at one focus; from the June solstice (152.0 million km, 29.3 km/s) to the December solstice (147.2 million km, 30.3 km/s), the axis stays tilted 23°26′ and points the same way in space
近日点（1 月初）快 · 远日点（7 月初）慢: Perihelion (early January) fast · aphelion (early July) slow
地轴与轨道面成 23°26′，空间指向不变: The axis makes 23°26′ with the orbital plane and keeps its direction in space
公转方向也是自西向东，与自转一致；一周是 1 年（回归年 365 日 5 时 4: Revolution is also west to east, the same as rotation; one orbit is 1 year (tropical year 365 d 5 h 48 min 46 s).
轨道是近似正圆的椭圆，太阳位于椭圆的一个焦点上；1 月初经过近日点（1.471: The orbit is a nearly circular ellipse with the Sun at one focus; perihelion is in early January (147.1 million km) and aphelion in early July (152.1 million km).
日地距离只变 3 % 左右，但公转速度随之变化：近日点线速度 30.3 km/s: The Earth–Sun distance changes only about 3 %, but orbital speed changes with it: at perihelion 30.3 km/s and 61′/day, at aphelion 29.3 km/s and 57′/day; the axis keeps its direction in space.
去掉这一步：解释不了北半球夏半年 186 天为什么比冬半年 179 天长——冬半: Skip this step and you cannot explain why the Northern Hemisphere's summer half-year (186 days) is longer than its winter half-year (179 days): the winter half passes perihelion, where Earth moves faster.
常考：1 月初近日点、7 月初远日点；近日点公转速度（线速度和角速度）都大。: Common exam point: perihelion in early January, aphelion in early July; orbital speed (both linear and angular) is greater at perihelion.
公转方向与自转一致（自西向东），轨道是近似正圆的椭圆、太阳在一个焦点上；1 月初: Revolution runs the same way as rotation (west to east) on a nearly circular ellipse with the Sun at one focus; perihelion in early January and aphelion in early July, with faster motion at perihelion, so the northern summer half-year is 7 days longer than the winter half.
facts A2.2 第 1、2、4、6、7 条（教材 p.3–4、p.14）、: facts A2.2 items 1, 2, 4, 6, 7 (textbook pp.3–4, p.14), item 8 (Fig. 1.4 note, L1)
同一时刻，为什么一半是白天、一半是黑夜？: At the same moment, why is half of Earth in day and half in night?
把世界时从 0 拖到 12，看地球在晨昏线下面转: Drag universal time from 0 to 12 and watch Earth turn beneath the terminator
太阳只能照亮地球的一半：向着太阳的是昼半球、背着的是夜半球，分界线就是晨昏线圈；: The Sun can light only half of Earth: the half facing it is the day hemisphere, the half facing away the night hemisphere, and the boundary is the terminator circle; on the June solstice the terminator just touches the Arctic Circle, and everything inside it is in the day hemisphere
同一时刻，太阳只能照亮地球表面的一半：向着太阳的半球是白昼（昼半球），背着太阳的: At any moment the Sun lights only half of Earth's surface: the half facing the Sun is in daylight (day hemisphere), the half facing away is in night (night hemisphere).
昼半球和夜半球的分界线（圈），叫作晨昏线（圈）。这一圈所在的平面永远正对太阳，所: The boundary (circle) between the day and night hemispheres is called the terminator. Its plane always faces the Sun, so it does not turn with Earth; Earth turns beneath it.
昼夜交替的周期是 1 个太阳日；这样的周期长短适宜，白昼不会过于炎热、黑夜不会过: Day and night alternate with a period of 1 solar day; this period is just right, so days are not too hot and nights not too cold.
去掉这一步：只会说「天亮了天黑了」，说不出那条线是什么、为什么会动。: Skip this step and you can only say "it got light, it got dark", without saying what that line is or why it moves.
易错：昼夜交替是地球自转造成的，周期 1 个太阳日（不是公转、不是 1 年）。: Common mistake: day and night are caused by Earth's rotation with a period of 1 solar day (not revolution, not 1 year).
太阳只能照亮地球表面的一半，昼半球和夜半球的分界线（圈）叫晨昏线（圈）；地球自转: The Sun lights only half of Earth's surface, and the boundary (circle) between day and night hemispheres is called the terminator; Earth's rotation makes day and night alternate with a period of 1 solar day.
晨昏线上，哪一半是晨线、哪一半是昏线？: On the terminator, which half is the dawn line and which the dusk line?
点一下地球上那半圈琥珀色的线（顺着自转方向由夜进昼的那半圈）: Click the amber half-circle on Earth (the half that goes from night into day in the direction of rotation)
顺自转方向（自西向东）由夜半球进入昼半球的那半圈是晨线（琥珀色），由昼半球进入夜: Going with rotation (west to east), the half that passes from the night hemisphere into the day hemisphere is the dawn line (amber), and the half from day into night is the dusk line (indigo); the sun's altitude is 0° at every point on both
顺自转方向：由夜进昼 = 晨线；由昼进夜 = 昏线: With rotation: night into day = dawn line; day into night = dusk line
晨昏线上太阳高度 0°；直射点上是 90°: Sun altitude 0° on the terminator; 90° at the subsolar point
一条晨昏圈上，一半是晨线、一半是昏线，判据是自转方向：顺着自转方向由夜进昼的就是: On a terminator circle, half is the dawn line and half the dusk line, judged by the direction of rotation: the part that passes from night into day with rotation is the dawn line.
由昼进夜的另外一半是昏线；地球转下去，晨线上的地方迎来日出，昏线上的地方迎来日落: The other half, from day into night, is the dusk line; as Earth turns, places on the dawn line see sunrise and places on the dusk line see sunset.
晨昏线上各点的太阳高度都是 0°（太阳刚在地平线上）；太阳直射点上太阳高度是 9: The sun's altitude is 0° everywhere on the terminator (the Sun just on the horizon); at the subsolar point it is 90°.
去掉这一步：看到一条线却分不出晨昏，判断不了某地是日出还是日落。: Skip this step and you see a line but cannot tell dawn from dusk, nor whether a place is at sunrise or sunset.
易错：判晨昏要沿自转方向（自西向东）看，不是沿经线往北看；晨线以东是昼半球。: Common mistake: dawn and dusk must be judged along the direction of rotation (west to east), not north along a meridian; east of the dawn line is the day hemisphere.
顺自转方向由夜半球进入昼半球的那半圈是晨线，由昼半球进入夜半球的那半圈是昏线；晨: The half that passes from the night hemisphere into the day hemisphere in the direction of rotation is the dawn line, and the half from day into night the dusk line; the sun's altitude on the terminator is 0°.
facts A2.3 第 1 条（p.7）、A2.6 第 1 条（p.11）、B: facts A2.3 item 1 (p.7), A2.6 item 1 (p.11), B2.9 test
东边的城市为什么先看到日出？: Why do cities to the east see sunrise first?
把经度从 180°W 拖到 180°E，盯住中控台的地方时读数: Drag longitude from 180°W to 180°E, watching the local time on the console
地方时 04:00 → 08:00（0° 经线）→ 16:00（180°E）：每: Local time 04:00 → 08:00 (0° meridian) → 16:00 (180°E): every 15° east, local time is 1 hour earlier; at the same instant different longitudes have different local times
东边比西边早 · 经度每隔 15°，地方时差 1 小时: Earlier in the east · every 15° of longitude, local time differs by 1 hour
地球自西向东转，同一纬度上东边的地点比西边的地点先看到日出，时间也就有了早迟之分: Earth turns west to east, so on the same latitude places to the east see sunrise before places to the west, and time differs accordingly.
经度每隔 15°，地方时相差 1 小时（1° = 4 分钟）；越在东边，时间越早: Every 15° of longitude, local time differs by 1 hour (1° = 4 minutes); the further east, the earlier.
地方时只跟经度有关、跟纬度无关：同一条经线上各地的地方时相同。: Local time depends only on longitude, not latitude: all places on one meridian share the same local time.
去掉这一步：算不出两地的时间差，后面的时区、区时、日界线全接不上。: Skip this step and you cannot work out the time difference between two places, and time zones, zone time and the date line all fall apart.
常考：给两地经度算地方时差；「北京时间」是东八区的区时（东经 120° 的地方时: Common exam point: work out the local time difference from two longitudes; "Beijing Time" is the zone time of UTC+8 (local time at 120°E), not Beijing's own (116°E) local time.
地球自西向东转，东边的地点比西边的先看到日出、时间更早；经度每隔 15° 地方时: Earth turns west to east, so places to the east see sunrise before places to the west and their time is earlier; every 15° of longitude, local time differs by 1 hour.
全世界都用地方时不行，怎么办？跨过 180° 为什么回到昨天？: Using local time everywhere won't work. What then? And why does crossing 180° take you back to yesterday?
把经度从 180°E 拖过 180° 到 180°W，盯住中控台说明行里的区时和: Drag longitude from 180°E across 180° to 180°W, watching the zone time and date in the console's caption line
东经 180°（东十二区）与西经 180°（西十二区）钟表时间都是 16:00，: At 180°E (UTC+12) and 180°W (UTC−12) clocks both read 16:00, but the dates differ by a day: June 21 in UTC+12, June 20 in UTC−12
全球 24 个时区 · 每区 15° · 相邻区时差 1 小时: 24 time zones worldwide · 15° each · neighboring zones differ by 1 hour
北京时间 = 东八区区时 = 东经 120° 的地方时: Beijing Time = UTC+8 zone time = local time at 120°E
地方时太碎没法用：全球分 24 个时区、每区跨 15°，以中央经线的地方时为区时: Local times are too fragmented to use: the world is divided into 24 time zones of 15° each, using the local time of the central meridian as zone time; neighboring zones differ by 1 hour, earlier to the east.
东十二区和西十二区各跨 7.5°、合为一个时区：区时相同，但日期差一天（东十二区: UTC+12 and UTC−12 each span 7.5° and together form one zone: same zone time, but the date differs by one day (UTC+12 is a day ahead of UTC−12).
原则上以 180° 经线为「今天」和「昨天」的分界线：自东十二区向东进入西十二区: In principle the 180° meridian divides "today" from "yesterday": going east from UTC+12 into UTC−12, the time stays the same and the date goes back one day; the other way, the date goes forward one day.
去掉这一步：跨日界线的日期会算错——教材里 F-22 战斗机导航系统失灵，就是电: Skip this step and dates across the date line are miscalculated; the F-22 fighters' navigation failure in the textbook happened because the electronics ignored the date change at the date line.
易错：自西向东越过 180° 经线，日期减一天（很多同学记反）；东十二区比西十二: Common mistake: crossing the 180° meridian from west to east, the date goes back a day (many students get this backward); UTC+12 is a day ahead of UTC−12.
全球分 24 个时区、每区跨 15°，区时取中央经线的地方时；以 180° 经线: The world is divided into 24 time zones of 15° each, with zone time taken from the central meridian's local time; the International Date Line is drawn along the 180° meridian, and going east from UTC+12 into UTC−12 the time stays the same while the date goes back a day.
facts A2.4 第 2–4、7–8 条（教材 p.8–10）、B2.6、B: facts A2.4 items 2–4, 7–8 (textbook pp.8–10), B2.6, B2.7
夏至这天，越往北白天越长，长到哪里为止？: On the June solstice, the further north the longer the day. Where does it stop?
把纬度从 40°N 拖到北极圈（66°34′N），盯住昼长读数: Drag latitude from 40°N to the Arctic Circle (66°34′N), watching the day length reading
昼长 14.84 h（40°N）→ 24.00 h（北极圈，极昼）；昼弧越来越长: Day length 14.84 h (40°N) → 24.00 h (Arctic Circle, polar day); the day arc grows longer and the night arc shorter; at the equator it is 12.00 h on any day
夏至：40°N 14.84 h，极圈以北极昼: June solstice: 40°N 14.84 h, polar day north of the Arctic Circle
晨昏线把所经过的纬线分成昼弧和夜弧：昼弧比夜弧长就昼长夜短，反之则昼短夜长。: The terminator divides each parallel it crosses into a day arc and a night arc: a day arc longer than the night arc means long days and short nights, and vice versa.
夏至太阳直射北回归线：北半球昼最长、夜最短，纬度越高昼越长，北极圈及其以北都是极: On the June solstice the Sun is overhead at the Tropic of Cancer: the Northern Hemisphere has its longest day and shortest night, days get longer with latitude, and everywhere at and north of the Arctic Circle has polar day; the Southern Hemisphere is the reverse.
冬至反过来：北半球昼最短、夜最长，北极圈以北极夜。把日期拖到春分对比一下：晨昏线: The December solstice is the reverse: the Northern Hemisphere has its shortest day and longest night, with polar night north of the Arctic Circle. Drag the date to an equinox to compare: the terminator passes through both poles and it is 12 hours everywhere.
去掉这一步：解释不了为什么哈尔滨的夏天比广州白天长、而冬天反过来。: Skip this step and you cannot explain why summer days in Harbin are longer than in Guangzhou, while winter is the other way round.
易错：赤道上也有昼夜交替，但全年没有昼夜长短变化；极昼就是昼长 24 小时。: Common mistake: the equator does have day and night, but day length never changes there all year; polar day means a 24-hour day.
昼长随纬度与季节变化：夏至北半球昼长夜短、纬度越高昼越长，北极圈以北极昼；赤道与: Day length varies with latitude and season: on the June solstice the Northern Hemisphere has long days and short nights, longer at higher latitudes, with polar day north of the Arctic Circle; at the equator and on the equinoxes, day and night are 12 h each everywhere.
facts A2.5 第 1–4 条（教材 p.11）、B2.4、B2.12、图: facts A2.5 items 1–4 (textbook p.11), B2.4, B2.12, Fig. 1.16
正午的太阳有多高，能不能到头顶？: How high is the noon sun? Can it be directly overhead?
把日期从夏至（172 日）拖到冬至（356 日），盯住正午太阳高度读数: Drag the date from the June solstice (day 172) to the December solstice (day 356), watching the noon sun altitude reading
北京（40°N）正午太阳高度 73.4°（夏至 73°26′）→ 26.6°（冬: Beijing (40°N) noon sun altitude 73.4° (June solstice 73°26′) → 26.6° (December solstice 26°34′); the subsolar point moves from the Tropic of Cancer to the Tropic of Capricorn
太阳高度是太阳光线与地平面的交角：直射点上 90°、晨昏线上 0°；正午太阳高度: Sun altitude is the angle between the Sun's rays and the horizontal plane: 90° at the subsolar point, 0° on the terminator; the noon sun altitude is the highest of the day.
H = 90° − |φ − δ|，离直射点纬度越近越大；40°N 夏至 73°: H = 90° − |φ − δ|, larger the closer the latitude is to the subsolar point; at 40°N, 73°26′ on the June solstice and 26°34′ on the December solstice.
